tip: Acabar de plus infinitive means to have just done something. Acabamos de receber = we have just received, a very recent past.
Acabar plus gerund means to end up doing something. Acabei dormindo = I ended up falling asleep, an unplanned outcome.
Andar plus gerund describes a recent ongoing tendency. Eles andam brigando = they have been fighting lately, not literally walking.
Deixar de plus infinitive means to stop or give up doing something. Deixei de tentar = I stopped trying.
